long_biography.plain_text:
John McMonigall joined Apax Partners in 1990 after managing customer-service operations at British Telecom. His move into venture investing came during a downturn in technology valuations, a setting he later recalled as both risky and full of opportunity. At Apax he came to lead telecommunications investments, bringing an operator's understanding to companies developing communications and software products.

His work carried into the boardrooms of listed and private technology companies. After two decades with Apax, McMonigall continued holding directorships and personal investments. He is a shareholder and director of Deontics, a clinical decision-support software business, and controls voting rights in a property company carrying his name.
